scope: Food safety, restaurant, culinary, hospitality, and foodservice professional development resources

records.name: ServSafe
records.description: National Restaurant Association training and certification programs covering food handlers, food managers, allergens, alcohol service, and workplace safety for restaurant and foodservice professionals.
records.availability_notes: Course, exam, proctoring, renewal, and state-recognition requirements vary by credential and location; current Indiana requirements should be checked before enrollment.

records.name: Indiana Restaurant & Lodging Association
records.description: Indiana professional association supporting restaurants, lodging businesses, hospitality staff, suppliers, educators, and students through advocacy, industry education, business resources, networking, and ServSafe certification access.
records.availability_notes: Membership benefits, event dates, certification classes, and pricing should be checked directly with the association.

records.name: National Restaurant Association
records.description: National restaurant-industry association providing advocacy, research, workforce development, professional education, operational guidance, and training and certification resources including ServSafe and foodservice-management credentials.
records.availability_notes: Some resources and benefits require membership or separate program enrollment.

records.name: International Association for Food Protection
records.description: Member-based professional association advancing food safety through scientific information exchange, conferences, webinars, publications, networking, and professional development.
records.availability_notes: Membership, conference, publication, and webinar access may have separate fees or eligibility conditions.

records.name: American Culinary Federation
records.description: Professional organization for chefs and culinary leaders offering nationally recognized culinary certifications, continuing education, apprenticeships, competitions, mentoring, events, networking, and career resources.
records.availability_notes: Certification prerequisites, membership dues, chapter availability, and event fees vary.

records.name: Association of Nutrition & Foodservice Professionals
records.description: Professional association supporting nutrition and foodservice managers through membership, continuing education, chapters, conferences, employer resources, and the Certified Dietary Manager, Certified Food Protection Professional credential pathway.
records.availability_notes: Credential eligibility, approved training programs, exam fees, continuing education, and membership benefits should be verified directly.
